recognize_zh: 抹片中一群小到中型的原始淋巴細胞，核質比極高、細胞質僅剩一圈嗜鹼性邊緣，染色質細緻到略濃縮、核仁不明顯，大小略有差異且無顆粒；與成熟淋巴球相比染色質較均勻細緻，符合前驅 B 細胞急性淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Cluster of small to intermediate blasts, about 1-1.5 times red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with fine to slightly condensed homogeneous chromatin
Inconspicuous nucleoli; no cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
One disrupted granular pink cell and normochromic red cells in the background
describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of small to intermediate-sized blasts in a background of normochromic red cells. The blasts have very high N:C ratios with a scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei with fine to slightly condensed homogeneous chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli, with mild variation in size. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are absent, and a single disrupted granular cell is present nearby. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry is required to confirm precursor B-cell lineage (CD19, CD10, CD79a, TdT, CD34).

ddx.vs: Hematogones are similar cytologically but show a normal, continuous maturation pattern of CD10, CD20 and CD34 on flow cytometry without aberrant antigens.
T-ALL is morphologically indistinguishable and requires cytoplasmic CD3 positivity without B-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are larger with more cytoplasm and express CD13/CD33/CD117 rather than B-cell markers.
CLL cells have coarse, clumped soccer-ball chromatin and are mature CD5+/CD23+ B cells without TdT.
